osm.validation_role: Construction/self-consistency check for the 32 OSM replacements; independent corroboration only for the five retained gazetteer positions.

diva.validation_role: Independent cross-source check; no DIVA coordinate was averaged into an output geometry. Candidate-disambiguation rows are selection-informed and excluded from the strict held-out subset. Same-name matching is not legal ground truth.

ward_exceptions.interpretation: All 40 residual cases were reviewed individually against INEC and an independent boundary service; three LGA attributes were corrected without geometry changes and 37 evidence-documented exceptions remain.

topology.interpretation: Zero active invalid geometries; hidden *_topology_original layers retain the 191 pre-correction defects as evidence.

topology_correction.algorithm: GEOS MakeValid linework; retain valid polygonal coverage; discard zero-area line residue

reviewed_cases.review_reason: Historical water class: self-crossing component lobes, principally the component near 6.86E/9.82N, have ambiguous signed area. MakeValid polygonises their intended positive lobes. Raster-era value comparison is not applicable to this historical picture product.

Gulf of Guinea: one self-crossing exterior ring forms an oppositely wound eastern marine lobe (about 1,868 km2). Invalid signed-area evaluation subtracts that lobe; MakeValid includes both marine lobes. The roughly two-lobe area increase is expected and all bounds remain unchanged.

Cross River National Park: five overlapping/nested input components are resolved to two valid polygons. Repaired area 3,294.375 km2 is closer to the independently stored WDPA area 3,318.661 km2 than the invalid signed-area result 3,462.900 km2; no coordinates are translated.

reviewed_extent_cases.review_reason: Precambrian basement polygon: MakeValid separates one vertical, zero-area LineString from the valid polygon. The line alone extends 0.006091117859 degrees north of the polygon. Dropping that collapsed line shrinks the feature envelope but changes no polygon coordinate or polygon area.

magnetic_coverage_reclassification.before_description: EMAG2 Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid v2, 2 arc-minute global total-field anomaly in nT (NOAA/NCEI / CIRES, free). Averaged to 0.025 degree and masked to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.
magnetic_coverage_reclassification.after_description: PARTIAL NIGERIA COVERAGE: 90.2% of sampled land cells are valid (Ekiti 0.0%, Osun 5.6%, Oyo 30.4%, Sokoto 40.2%). Missing areas remain NoData; no interpolation or magnetic infilling was applied. This is not continuous national coverage. EMAG2 Earth Magnetic Anomaly Grid v2, 2 arc-minute global total-field anomaly in nT (NOAA/NCEI / CIRES, free), averaged to 0.025 degree and masked to Nigeria. EPSG:4326.

comparison_notes: Historical picture polygons for climate, soil and population are not the same product/year as the modern rasters; their value disagreement is not used as a coordinate-failure test.
Land-mask agreement detects gross raster shifts but does not validate the physical accuracy of each cell value.
